assertions.name: catalogue_reachable_and_schur_weyl_consistent
assertions.source: Phase 1.3 read-through: lookup_derived succeeds on all 3 Borromean cells, and 4·χ^(3) + 2·χ^(2,1) reconstructs the Schur-Weyl V⊗³ trace 8 − 6h⁴ − 2h⁶ from T17 to within 1e-40 at two test q-values.

assertions.name: failing_loud_guard_raises_on_missing_cell
assertions.source: The catalogue's derived-only lookup must raise on missing cells (e.g. T(3,4)/(3,1)/color-binding, a Phase-3+ target that pulls in higher-strand structure), so any production wire-up that expects derived cannot silently consume `cal-anchored` or `extracted` values.

description: Phase 1.3 read-through demo: prove the catalogue is reachable from compute and that its three Borromean cells cross-check the Schur-Weyl trace identity. No production file modified.

data.phase_3_next_step: Phase 2 adds Trefoil/Cinquefoil/4₁ rows; Phase 3 swaps extracted χ^λ reads in closed_form_tau_M.py + the per-atom mass sweep for `lookup_derived` calls. The failing-loud guard then enforces that any site asking for `tier='derived'` cannot silently consume a `cal-anchored` value.
